L10·N853unmasked layer
This neuron has no crisp lexical trigger — its "max" activations are weak, diffuse firings spread over ordinary mid-sentence tokens in informal web/product prose (e.g. the numeral "2" in game titles, sentence-openers like "It"/"Apart", " one of the most", the "w" of "smartwatches"), while its real signal is the large negative side, strongly suppressed at phrase-closing/abbreviation-parenthesis tokens like ")." and relational connectives such as "related (to)" and "as of".
